{{Short description|Russian philosopher}}{{Family name hatnote|Ivanovich|Karinski|lang=East Slavic}}[[File:Михаил Каринский.jpg|thumb|Michael Ivanovich Karinski]]

'''Michael Ivanovich Karinski''' ({{Langx|ru|Михаил Иванович
Каринский}}; 1840&ndash;1917) was a Russian [[philosopher]].<ref name="Zenkovsky2003">{{cite book|author=V. V. Zenkovsky|title=A History of Russian Philosophy, Volume II|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=iyZTr9si5KAC&pg=PA584|accessdate=24 April 2012|year=2003|publisher=Routledge|isbn=978-0-415-30306-4|pages=584–5}}</ref> His ''[[Classification of Inferences]]'' (1880) has been called "the most important single work in [[logical theory]] that nineteenth-century Russia produced."<ref>''[[Journal of Philosophy]]'', Vol. 50, p.185</ref>

==Works==
* ''Classification of Inferences'', 1880
